name: Lomda Builder Agent
description: An agent that turns a content owner's source material (slides, documents, links) into a ready-to-publish interactive Hebrew e-learning module, with human approval at every major stage.
target_audience: Content owners: safety officers, legal advisors, HR and training managers
tasks_capable_of_performing: Source material analysis and learning objectives mapping
Hebrew lesson content and quiz writing
Interactive illustration and decision diagram generation
examples_of_suitable_questions: Create a training lesson on winter driving from C:\docs\winter.pptx
Build a compliance lesson from our code of ethics PDF
Add a decision diagram to screen 4 of the lesson
